title: MZ Discrepancy between text display in VisuStella WeaknessPopups and VisualStateEffects

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
With WeaknessPopups, weakness/resist/absorb have their own font style, as well as growing+shrinking when they display before fading out.
VisualStateEffects has a reflect popup, and it shows up the same way the builtin RPG Maker MZ damage numbers/miss text does.
Any way to get WeaknessPopups to do the same as VisualStateEffects? I don't want two different styles for feedback in my game if possible.
